race.comment: MISS VERSTAK (10) looks a handy one on debut for the Waller camp. A Bivouac filly out of Catchulata, she's a half to the G1 & 2 placed Tupakara. Fitted fit a stylish Gold Coast trial win, the filly draws the A1 and can make an immediate impact. Which is exactly what LA BELLA QUEEN (2) did here two weeks ago when leading pillar-to-post. Will look to lead again from the low draw and deserves strong consideration again with race experience under her belt. BETTER THE DEVIL (7) debuts and benefits from the Gollan and Thompson combination. Draws well in barrier four and has enough stable and pedigree support to be respected as a genuine threat. VELVET HUSTLE (11) is another debutante that looks capable enough.
